name: Syncro
summary: Syncro combines RMM with a PSA for managed service providers and prices per technician, not per endpoint. The Core plan costs $129 per user per month on annual billing or $159 monthly, and Team costs $179 or $209. Endpoints are unlimited on both plans, and a 14-day trial needs no credit card.

facts.text: Pricing is per technician who uses Syncro, not per client or per endpoint.
The Team plan includes Microsoft 365 management, which the Core plan does not.
Syncro lists Microsoft 365 Cloud Backup at $1.90 per user per month as an add-on.
Scripts run in PowerShell and Mac shell, with a library of ready-made scripts from Syncro and its user community.
AI features are free through January 2027, after which they run on usage-based AI credits with a monthly free pool. The page gives no credit price.

plans.name: Core (annual)
plans.notes: Annual commitment, paid monthly. Unlimited endpoints
